meta.name: hunt-csrf
meta.description: Hunting skill for csrf vulnerabilities. Built from 15 public bug bounty reports including modern variants — SameSite=Lax sibling-subdomain bypass (Argo CD CVE-2024-22424), GraphQL mutations-via-GET (GitLab $3,370), framework-wide CSRF middleware disabled (Stripe Dashboard $5,000), path-traversal CSRF-token bypass (GitHub Enterprise CVE-2022-23732 $10k), Origin-omission bypass (TikTok $2,500), OAuth-state null-byte (Streamlabs), WebSocket CSRF / CSWSH (Coda), default-SameSite email-change → ATO (YoYo Games $400), social-account-link CSRF (HackerOne), JSON-CSRF via text/plain on email-change (TikTok $500). Use when hunting modern CSRF — heavy emphasis on chain-to-ATO patterns.

copy.tagline: 发现并利用现代 CSRF 漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做 Web 安全测试或漏洞赏金，需要系统化检测 CSRF 缺陷。
copy.tagline_en: Find and exploit modern CSRF vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do web security testing or bug bounty and need systematic CSRF detection.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你寻找跨站请求伪造漏洞。它会分析网站的状态变更接口、检查 Cookie 的 SameSite 属性、测试 CSRF 令牌是否可预测或可复用，并尝试绕过常见的防御措施。
howto.when: 当你需要审计一个 Web 应用是否存在 CSRF 漏洞时触发，尤其是涉及账户接管、OAuth 流程、JSON API 或第三方集成的场景。

say.text: 帮我检查这个网站的 CSRF 防护是否到位。
测试这个 OAuth 回调是否存在 CSRF 漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会检查 RelayState 参数是否被验证。

say.text: 看看这个 JSON 接口能否通过 text/plain 表单绕过 CSRF。
say.note: Claude 会尝试用 text/plain 编码发送请求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you find Cross-Site Request Forgery vulnerabilities. It maps state-changing endpoints, checks SameSite cookie attributes, tests CSRF token predictability/reuse, and attempts bypasses of common defenses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to audit a web application for CSRF vulnerabilities, especially those involving account takeover, OAuth flows, JSON APIs, or third-party integrations.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze state-changing endpoints and cookie settings.

say_en.text: Test this OAuth callback for CSRF.
say_en.note: Claude will check if the RelayState parameter is validated.

say_en.text: See if this JSON endpoint can be bypassed via text/plain form.
say_en.note: Claude will attempt to send a request with text/plain encoding.
